nina.docs: FYI teamwe're standardizing the embeddings API param name. We're renaming `normalize_embeddings` -> `embeddings_norm` across docs and SDKs.

Reason: the new name aligns with the runtime flag and avoids confusion with boolean vs. method configs.

Timeline: rollout next Tue; 30-day deprecation window. SDKs will accept both keys during the window and log a one-line warning.

Migration notes:
- Docs: examples will be updated to `embeddings_norm` immediately.
- SDKs: Python/JS/Rust adapters will map old key to new. Patch releases published same day as rollout.
- Hosted API: server accepts both for 30 days, then returns 400 for `normalize_embeddings` after cutoff.
- Dedicated/Private: we'll publish a runtime patch plus an opt-in compatibility package for one maintenance cycle.

Example change (Python):
```py
# old
client.embeddings.create(model=\"embed-small\", input=text, normalize_embeddings=\"l2\")

# new
client.embeddings.create(model=\"embed-small\", input=text, embeddings_norm=\"l2\")
```

omar.ml: Will existing stored configs in customer repos (yaml/json) break? We should give a grep snippet for ops.

nina.docs: Good call  I'll add a `rg` example to the migration guide. Internal link: https://redwood.internal/migrations/embeddings-norm

ryan.sdk: SDK behavior: patch releases will accept both keys and emit a DeprecationWarning (py) / console.warn (js). We'll also add CI lint checks to our SDK repos to flag the old key.

infra-bot: Note: scheduled docs build Wed 04:00 UTC. We'll coordinate deploy order: SDK patches -> hosted API shim -> docs publish.

lisa.sales: For enterprise customers with Dedicated installs, can we provide a one-liner to apply the compatibility package? They'll want something easy to share with their infra teams.

ryan.sdk: Yes  we'll publish a single tarball and a small script in the release notes. Example: `curl -sSL https://releases.redwood/compat/embeddings-norm.sh | bash` (documented and gated).

devtools: Suggest a temporary CODEOWNERS pr to require a quick review on any PRs that touch embeddings config to ensure migration. Can open it today.

nina.docs: Action items quick list:
- [x] Docs examples updated (nina)
- [x] Internal migration guide published (nina)
- [x] SDK patches accepting both keys + warnings (ryan)
- [ ] Dedicated compatibility artifact + script (ryan/infra)
- [ ] Monorepo grep/lint rule + CODEOWNERS tweak (devtools)
- [ ] Changelog + support blurb for AMs (lisa)

If you own an unchecked item, drop a thumbs-up and link the PR/issue. We'll cover this in the weekly SDK sync. Thanks!
